label: a
rationale: All computability-theory batches stay together, covering circuit, proof-system, randomness, oracle, jump, and degree material.

label: b
rationale: Measure theory, probabilistic convergence, and Fourier series share the measure-and-analysis foundations needed for coherent review.

label: c
rationale: Functional analysis, harmonic PDE, and differential geometry form a closely related analytic and geometric cluster.

label: d
rationale: Number theory, Lie theory, and representation theory are algebraic subjects with shared structural and representation methods.

label: e
rationale: Homological algebra, cellular homology, and differential topology belong together through homology and topological constructions.

label: f
rationale: Commutative algebra, algebraic geometry, and scheme theory share the local algebra and geometric language central to these batches.

label: g
rationale: The co-e-free combinatorial-structure batch is a distinct specialty with no comparably close remaining batch.
